who.title: Which photos
who.label: Who's in them
who.hint: Photos with any of them. Photos of you with them count too.

people.none: No one chosen: every photo from those dates.

theme.label: Theme
theme.hint: Optional. Photos that match come first.

avoid.label: Avoid
avoid.hint: Optional. Photos that look like this drop way down.

album.label: Immich album
album.tip: Tip: in Immich, select photos and choose “Add to album”.

sensitive.title: Sensitive photos
sensitive.sub: Shirtless, in swimwear, in diapers or in the bath, going by the AI tags. They're always marked with <icon/>.

show.title: Suggest with a warning
show.desc: They can show up; each one gets a warning so you can review it.

avoid.title: Avoid them
avoid.desc: Only if there's nothing better for that moment of the song.

never.title: Never suggest them
never.desc: Not in suggestions or when changing a photo (you can still add them by hand).

pace.label: Pace
pace.more: It follows the song: the chorus goes a bit faster; intro, bridge and ending, slower. Changing it redoes the shots.

confirm.title: Change the pace?
confirm.body: This redoes the shots. Photos (pinned ones too) move to the new shot at the same moment; if two pinned photos land on the same shot, one of them stays. Empty shots get filled when you suggest again. You can undo it.

order.label: Photo order
order.flexLead: It can move a photo earlier or later by up to
order.strictDesc: Photos always go in date order.
order.freeDesc: No date order: whichever photo fits each line best.

motion.label: Camera movement
motion.hint: You can change each shot in the Storyboard step.
motion.desc: Lively: more whip pans and diptychs. Calm: gentle zooms, no whip pans.

videos.label: Videos
videos.desc: Some: ≈ 15% of the shots are video clips. Plenty: ≈ 35%.

subtitles.label: Subtitles
subtitles.hint: The lyrics burned into the video.

desc.some_one: Pick them with the subtitle icon on each shot or in the lyrics. Now: {{count}} line.
desc.some_other: Pick them with the subtitle icon on each shot or in the lyrics. Now: {{count}} lines.
desc.all: Every line shows on screen, in sync with the song.

learning.label: Learning
learning.hint: What the app learns from your changes.
learning.desc: From scratch: the factory weights, without what it learned from your corrections.

summary.title: In the video
summary.changed: You changed {{list}} since the last suggestion: changes apply when you suggest again.

suggest.keepsPinned_one: Keeps your pinned photo. The rest may change.
suggest.keepsPinned_other: Keeps your {{count}} pinned photos. The rest may change.
suggest.mayChangeAll: Any of them may change: pin the ones you want to keep.
suggest.firstHint: Picks a photo for each shot. Then you review them in the Storyboard step.
suggest.needsSong: First analyze the song in the <link>Song</link> step.

excluded.title: Removed from this video
excluded.restored: Restored: it can show up in suggestions again
excluded.hint: “Don't use” puts them here. Tap one to restore it.

pool.title: Candidate photos
pool.counting: Counting the photos for these filters and how many are analyzed…
pool.total_one: {{count, number}} photo or video with these filters
pool.total_other: {{count, number}} photos and videos with these filters
pool.offline: {{name}} is off: {{n, number}} not analyzed. Those photos may show up without the sensitive photo warning, and their quality (eyes, smile, focus) doesn't count when choosing. Turn it on and they'll be analyzed on their own.
pool.note: Quality, faces and tags (that's where the sensitive photo warnings come from).
pool.onSuggest: Anything left gets done when you suggest.
